周文睿

Wenrui Zhou

I’m a Ph.D. student in Electronic and Computer Engineering at HKUST, advised by Ling Pan. I’m a Hong Kong PhD Fellow.

My previous work spans databases, large language models (LLMs), and electronic design automation (EDA). I now focus on reinforcement learning (RL) for AI infrastructure and embodied AI.

I received my B.Eng. from the School of Computer Science and Technology at Beijing Institute of Technology in 2025.

In my free time, I compete in and judge English debates. I still hold an English debate record at BIT. I also enjoy teaching and giving lectures. Debate CV
